author: blu
body: Shared CodexType transformations used across the type checker, IR lowering, and emitters. Each helper has one canonical definition; duplicates in IR/LoweringTypes, TypeCheckerInference, and X86_64Compound were consolidated here.

author: reek
body: LinearTy marks a declared-linear position (ownership stage 1). It is transparent to unification and representation: unify-at strips both sides at entry so no substitution ever carries the wrapper, and bind-def-params binds parameters stripped so body inference and the IR never see it. The wrapper survives only on the registered signature, where the stage-2 ownership walk will read it.
